Sebastian Kolowa, bishop of the Usambara-Digo (North-Eastern) Diocese, succeeded Stephen Moshi as presiding bishop of the ELCT in the mid-1970s. My earlier answer was wrong: Alex Malasusa's 2017 election came decades after Moshi's tenure, so he was not Moshi's successor. I can't check either name against a live source in this session, so please confirm before relying on it.

CONFIDENCE: 55
